title: ConfRetro: a 3D-aware template-free method for enhancing retrosynthesis via molecular conformer information
abstract: arXiv:2501.12434v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Motivation: Retrosynthesis plays a crucial role in organic synthesis and drug discovery, focusing on identifying a set of reactants capable of synthesizing a target product molecule. Although the existing approaches have shown promising results, they do not fully exploit 3D conformer information and molecular spatial structure, which can hinder stereochemically consistent and chemically plausible predictions.   Results: To tackle this problem, we propose ConfRetro, a Transformer-based template-free method that integrates molecular conformer information and spatial structure. We devise an Atom-align Fusion module to combine 3D positional information at the model input stage, ensuring alignment between atom tokens and corresponding 3D representations. translated_title: ConfRetro：一种利用分子构象信息增强逆合成分析的3D感知无模板方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.12434v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：动机：逆合成分析在有机合成和药物发现中扮演着关键角色，其重点在于识别能够合成目标产物分子的一组反应物。尽管现有方法已显示出有前景的结果，但它们并未充分利用3D构象信息和分子空间结构，这可能阻碍立体化学一致性和化学合理性预测。结果：为解决此问题，我们提出了ConfRetro，这是一种基于Transformer的无模板方法，整合了分子构象信息和空间结构。我们设计了一个原子对齐融合模块，在模型输入阶段结合3D位置信息，确保原子标记与相应的3D表示对齐。此外，我们设计了一种距离加权注意力机制来引导自注意力，约束模型的感受野，并强调3D中化学相关的原子对。
tldr: ConfRetro通过引入原子对齐融合模块和距离加权注意力机制，利用3D构象信息提升逆合成预测的立体化学一致性和化学合理性。
en_tdlr: ConfRetro enhances retrosynthesis prediction by integrating 3D conformer information via an Atom-align Fusion module and a Distance-weighted Attention mechanism, improving stereochemical consistency and chemical plausibility.
